candidates.place_reason: 306d audit 2026-10-12: similarity (8 pts, resid 10.9-39 m, 2.63 m/px, +1.1 deg); the 8 anchors are a 100-px grid ladder (three on the left edge, whose 200/100-px lat steps span 0.0054/0.0018 deg - a 1.5:1 ratio no similarity can hit), so the residuals only measure the grid's own inconsistency, and the fit's 2.63 m/px is ~1.8x the plate's own 'SCALE OF FEET 0-300' bar (~1.45 m/px). The drawn hachured hillfort (~280-340 m across) maps to (-3.5187, 51.0370), ~550-580 m N-NW of the real Burr Castle hillfort (the ~80-90 m hachured ring just NW of the site point on the OS maps; LiDAR bump at the same spot), on a small hachured wood hill. Document deleted.
